title: Euler trail criterion via odd-degree vertices
statement: Let $G$ be a connected simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$. Then $G$ admits an Eulerian trail — a walk between some pair of vertices $u,v$ that traverses every edge of $G$ exactly once — if and only if the number of vertices of odd degree is at most $2$.
replaced:
Cor 4.1: a connected graph has an Euler trail iff at most two vertices have odd degree.

A connected graph has an Euler trail if and only if it has at
most two vertices of odd degree.
